# Crush

> Compress JPG, PNG and WebP in the browser with Canvas. No upload, no watermark.

The public origin is https://crush-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Compress](https://crush-local.vercel.app/) — Batch JPG/PNG/WebP in this tab.
* [Target size](https://crush-local.vercel.app/target) — Fit a still under a byte cap.

## Guides

* [How to compress](https://crush-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, quality, ZIP.
* [WhatsApp](https://crush-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Chat recode vs document.
* [Email](https://crush-local.vercel.app/email) — Gmail 25 MB is the letter.
* [iPhone](https://crush-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Files vs Photos.
* [Quality](https://crush-local.vercel.app/quality) — What Canvas can and cannot keep.
* [Use cases](https://crush-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Portal, listing, deck.
* [FAQ](https://crush-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy and limits.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API, no HEIC decoder, and no `/blogs/` cluster.
